vuln.name: Application Error / Stack Trace Disclosed
vuln.description: The application returns a detailed error message or stack trace to the client when an unexpected condition occurs. The trace reveals implementation details: file paths, library versions, SQL fragments, and sometimes credentials or session data.
vuln.impact: Information leakage from stack traces helps an attacker fingerprint the stack and craft targeted attacks. Repeated triggering can also enable denial of service.
vuln.recommendation: Disable detailed error output in production. Return a generic error page and log full traces server-side only. Set framework debug flags to false and use a production error handler.

reference.title: CWE-209: Information Exposure Through Error Message
